description: Data-driven three-depth backgrounds for authored underground maps.

underground.glow_moss.visual_language: Rounded root vaults, giant luminous fungi, hanging vines and drifting spores.

underground.crystal_mine.visual_language: Deep geodes crossed by abandoned mine braces, hoists and cold reflected light.

underground.magma_hell.visual_language: Basalt teeth, infernal furnaces, distant lava falls, broken chains and embers.

underground.underground_castle.visual_language: Ruined keeps, layered arches, barred windows, torn banners and hanging chains.

underground.boss_dungeon.visual_language: Abyssal ritual halls, colossal ribs, sealed monoliths, void sigils and chained gates.

underground.egyptian_pyramid.visual_language: Layered limestone halls, recessed columns, hieroglyph bands, sarcophagi and torch niches.
